facebookresearch_tdfbanks/melfilters.py.create_Gabor_instance: create a Gabor object with 40 mel filters for audio feature extraction at 16kHz sample rate
facebookresearch_tdfbanks/melfilters.py.build_mel_filters: build a mel filter bank matrix by calling Gabor._build_mels() to generate triangular filters in the mel scale
facebookresearch_tdfbanks/melfilters.py.build_gabor_wavelets: build Gabor wavelet filters from mel filter parameters using Gabor._build_gabors() for time-frequency analysis
facebookresearch_tdfbanks/melfilters.py.convert_hz_to_mel: convert a frequency in hertz to the mel scale using Gabor._hz2mel() for perceptual audio analysis
facebookresearch_tdfbanks/melfilters.py.compute_mel_filter_energy: compute the energy of a mel filter by calling Gabor._melfilter_energy() to get area under the magnitude spectrum

facebookresearch_tdfbanks/model.py.initialize_TDFbanks_Gabor: initialize the TDFbanks complex convolution weights using Gabor filters with a specified frequency range
facebookresearch_tdfbanks/model.py.run_TDFbanks_forward: run the TDFbanks forward pass on an audio waveform tensor to extract time-domain filterbank features
facebookresearch_tdfbanks/model.py.review_TDFbanks_architecture: review the TDFbanks class architecture including complex convolution, squared modulus, and log compression layers

facebookresearch_tdfbanks/utils.py.create_chirp_signal: create a linear chirp signal from frequency f0 to f1 over duration T at sampling rate fs
facebookresearch_tdfbanks/utils.py.create_hanning_window: create a Hanning window array of length N for signal processing
facebookresearch_tdfbanks/utils.py.create_hamming_window: create a Hamming window array of length N for signal processing
facebookresearch_tdfbanks/utils.py.test_chirp_function: test the chirp function by generating a signal between 100Hz and 1000Hz over 1 second
